comment: Committed byte-digest membership manifest for the golden checker-transcript corpus (W-7 anti-substitution floor). Enforced by name-set equality plus per-file sha256 identity in menagerie.crawler.tools.golden_corpus_floor.enforce(); consumed by the in-suite anti-substitution test, the production calibration activation gate, and the receipt mint/verify path. Regenerate ONLY via `python -m menagerie.crawler.tools.golden_corpus_floor write`; never hand-edit. The retired list is a PERMANENT census — rows are appended by --retire and removed only by an explicit --reactivate reviewed change.
